gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (GIVE) their medals by the mayor last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night' + agent 'by the mayor': past simple passive were given.

gaps.sentence: Passengers ___ (ask) to fasten their seatbelts before take-off.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + asked. The agent (crew) is obvious and omitted.
The policy receives the action: 'will be introduced'.

gaps.sentence: By this time tomorrow, the results ___ to every candidate.
gaps.explanation: 'By this time tomorrow' requires future perfect passive: will have been + emailed.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript is said ___ in a private vault for decades.
gaps.explanation: 'For decades' before now: perfect passive infinitive to have been + kept.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript ___ (BELIEVE) to be the composer’s last work.
gaps.explanation: 'People believe it is…' becomes 'it is believed to be…'.

gaps.sentence: These wires must ___ by a qualified electrician.
gaps.explanation: After a modal, passive = be + past participle: must be checked. 'Been' needs 'have'.

gaps.sentence: He ___ to be the best chef in the region.
gaps.explanation: 'People think he is …' → 'he is thought to be …'.
